title: lepturus latifolius
intro: Lepturus latifolius, commonly known as Indian rye grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is a medicinal plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurveda, for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Lepturus latifolius include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-diabetic, and antimicrobial properties.
